meta.name: cloudflare-one-migrations
meta.description: Assess and plan migrations from existing VPN, SWG, or SASE platforms to Cloudflare One, including policy mapping, parity gaps, and rollout.

copy.tagline: 规划从旧 VPN 或安全网关迁到 Cloudflare One,映射策略并评估差距
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在用 VPN、SWG 或 SASE,想评估迁到 Cloudflare One 的路径
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run VPN/SWG/SASE today and need a rollout plan to Cloudflare One

howto.what: 它是迁移评估规划助手：先要求导出配置和日志，梳理身份、应用、策略等对象，把每条源规则映射到 Cloudflare One 的目标资源并用缺口标注，最后生成带验证与回滚步骤的迁移评估表。
howto.when: 当你说要把现有 VPN、SWG 或 SASE 平台迁到 Cloudflare One，或要求做策略映射、能力差距、分阶段上线评估时，会用这套流程。

say.text: 把这些源规则映射到 Cloudflare One，标出部分支持和不迁移项。
传统 VPN 迁到 Cloudflare One，怎么做分阶段上线？
say.note: 会建议小范围试点并对比日志后再扩大。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a migration planning assistant: asks for exports and logs, inventories identities/apps/policies, maps each source rule to Cloudflare One targets with gaps flagged, then outputs an assessment with validation and rollback steps.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say you are migrating an existing VPN, SWG, or SASE platform to Cloudflare One, or ask for policy mapping, capability gap assessment, or staged rollout planning.

say_en.text: I'm migrating Zscaler to Cloudflare One; list the config exports I need.
say_en.note: It will ask for exports and logs first.

say_en.text: Map these source rules to Cloudflare One; flag partial and unmigrated items.
say_en.note: Each rule must map or become a Not Migrated row.

say_en.text: How should I stage a legacy VPN migration to Cloudflare One?
say_en.note: It will suggest piloting and comparing logs.
